name: Associate Degree of Music (Performance)
reason: Genuinely accredited but with zero live marketing presence found anywhere: TEQSA's national register lists "Associate Degree of Music (Performance)" as currently accredited, renewal date 27/10/2029 (not expired, not teach-out), yet it has no page on aim.edu.au (absent from the courses sitemap, course guide, course-search dropdown and WP site search), no UAC undergraduate listing (the UAC course-search filtered to AIM lists only 9 Bachelor/Diploma/Undergraduate-Certificate titles, no Associate Degrees), and Industri Education (AIM's Associate Degree delivery partner) markets only two Associate Degrees, Live Production and Live Music Business, neither of which is this course.
